slice.claim_or_method: A Chat-native crash-window gate can order an external effect after durable role-local checkpoint verification: write checkpoint, exact-read it back and verify identity/content, then and only then invoke the later effect. If the write or readback fails, the effect is not invoked and the continuation remains open for the next scheduler firing.
direct_observation: The current GitHub connector exposes a create_file mutation and repository file fetch/readback capability as separate synchronous tool operations.
The current reasoning control explicitly permits role-local or immutable own-receipt repository mutation with exact readback and requires cross-invocation recovery rather than same-run waiting.
inference: Because later tool calls are issued only after earlier tool results are returned, the reasoning process can condition issuance of a subsequent effect on a successful exact readback predicate without richer-mode, protected-primary, or manual-user execution.

The gate converts the pre-effect crash window into a fail-closed branch: failure before verified readback yields no later effect; failure after the effect remains a separate idempotency/reconciliation problem for the effect itself.
assumption: A later effect surface, when selected in a future bounded leaf, is invokable only after the agent evaluates the readback result and is not independently pre-scheduled outside this gate.
GitHub exact readback of the created blob is sufficient evidence of API-visible checkpoint durability for this role-local transport layer.
uncertainty: This slice validates the control-flow architecture and available repository primitives, not a live non-repository external effect.
Post-effect exactly-once semantics remain unresolved and require effect-specific idempotency or reconciliation evidence.
slice.confidence: high for pre-effect gating architecture; low for untested effect-specific exactly-once behavior
provenance_pointer: runtime GitHub connector schema exposing create_file plus fetch/readback operations
disconfirmation_or_alternative_explanati: If a target effect is independently triggered or queued before the readback predicate is evaluated, this gate does not protect it.
If a target effect lacks an idempotency key or observable reconciliation surface, a crash after effect execution but before effect-result checkpointing can still duplicate the effect on retry.
slice.material_change_reason: new method interaction: explicit pre-effect durability gate separates checkpoint verification from effect-specific post-effect exactly-once recovery

tested_scope.acceptance_limit: Only the pre-effect gating architecture is supported by this slice; no claim is made that an arbitrary external effect already satisfies exactly-once semantics.

continuation: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation and exact-read reasoning role-local state/LATEST first.
